[[File:HolographicMicrocomputer-SWTOR.png|thumb|A holographic microcomputer]]
A '''holographic microcomputer''' was a field [[Computer/Legends|computer]] device, popular during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Lost microcomputers were found across the Galaxy, and often picked up by [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], who sold them at the bazaar in [[Mos Ila]].<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>
